pricing.basis: Standard API per million tokens; short context; uncached proxy only

families.label: Bounded code mapping and low-risk patches
Structured defect localization with exact source evidence
Multi-file contract, producer, consumer, and acceptance state integration
Compatibility, implementation, rollback, and acceptance state transitions

limitations: Cost proxies exclude cache discounts/writes, long-context surcharges, service-tier differences, tool fees and infrastructure replacements.
Codex subscription credits cannot be inferred from API prices.
Cost-per-success ratios are descriptive; they are not a retry-policy simulation or confidence bound.
Worker evidence does not establish a live coordinator default or broad security/concurrency capability.
SUPPORTED in the embedded analysis means quality and generation-latency support, not monetary savings or policy promotion.
